Meetings and conferences Alexandria, Egypt 31 August 2026 - 2 September 2026 In person Enhancing Alexandria’s climate resilience through the Alexandria Consortium and MCR2030 Alexandria faces a complex and interconnected risk landscape shaped by coastal hazards, climate change, rapid urban growth, infrastructure exposure and increasing pressure on essential services. Meetings and conferences Geneva 3 September 2026 - 4 September 2026 In person Sixth global expert forum for producers and users of disaster related statistics 6th Global Expert Forum for Producers and Users of Disaster-related Statistics, in hybrid format. Geneva, Switzerland, from 3-4 September 2026. Meetings and conferences Addis Ababa 2 September 2026 - 4 September 2026 In person Register Now: Africa Early Warnings Forum, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia 2-4 September 2026 The Africa Early Warnings Forum will serve as an implementation and partnership platform focused on recommendations for rapidly scaling effective and sustainable multi-hazard early warning systems across Africa. Meetings and conferences Incheon 7 September 2026 - 8 September 2026 In person International Disaster Resilience Leaders Forum Incheon 2026 (IDRLF2026) - Translating Locally-led Resilience into Action in the Age of Complex Risk and Digital Transformation International Disaster Resilience Leaders Forum 2025 is convened to feature a series of thematic and networking sessions designed to promote experience sharing on successful international cooperation initiatives and practical local action for DRR. Meetings and conferences Damascus, Syrian Arab Republic 12 October 2026 - 14 October 2026 In person 2nd Arab Forum on Early Warning Systems and Disaster Preparedness The 2nd Arab Forum on Early Warning Systems and Disaster Preparedness will convene governments and regional partners to strengthen multi-hazard early warning systems and regional cooperation while advancing implementation of the EW4All initiative. Training event Chiba, Japan 20 October 2026 - 22 October 2026 In person Training workshop on the Global Disaster-Related Statistics Framework (G-DRSF) Enhancing country capacity on the Global Disaster-Related Statistics Framework (G-DRSF) Meetings and conferences Baghdad, Iraq 18 November 2026 - 19 November 2026 In person Building Risk-Informed and Resilient SMEs in the Arab Region UNDRR ROAS will convene a regional workshop in Baghdad to strengthen SME resilience across the Arab States by promoting disaster risk reduction, business continuity planning, resilient supply chains and public-private partnerships. Meetings and conferences Bucharest 25 May 2027 - 27 May 2027 In person Europe and Central Asia Regional Platform for Disaster Risk Reduction The next Europe and Central Asia Regional Platform for Disaster Risk Reduction (RP2027) will take place 25–27 May 2027 in Bucharest, Romania, hosted by the Government of Romania. After-Event Reviews of Early Warning Systems. This webinar marks the official launch of the guidance and provides an opportunity to introduce the AER methodology. Meetings and conferences 4 August 2026 Online Pacific Webinar on the Global Disaster-Related Statistics Framework (G-DRSF) This webinar, organized by UNDRR, ESCAP and SPC, will introduce the Global Disaster-Related Statistics Framework and explore its practical relevance for countries in the Pacific region. Meetings and conferences Tripoli, Libya 27 July 2026 - 29 July 2026 Online Arab countries strengthen disaster-risk knowledge and governance through South-South exchange As Arab countries face increasingly complex risks, including floods, wildfires, droughts, coastal hazards, industrial emergencies and climate-related extremes, strengthening risk knowledge and disaster-risk governance has become essential. Training event 28 July 2026 Online El Niño 2026-2027: Business Preparedness in the Americas and the Caribbean The window that opens between the seasonal forecast and the event's peak is a strategic asset: acting now, while there is still time, can make the difference between operational continuity and significant losses. Primarily Spanish-language content. Training event 24 July 2026 Online EW4All webinar: Accelerating cell broadcast for effective Early Warning Systems in Africa On Wednesday, 24 July 2026, UNDRR's Regional Office for Africa and EW4All partners will host a webinar providing an introductory and practical overview of Cell Broadcast for early warning in Africa. Meetings and conferences 22 July 2026 Online Launch of the Operational Guidance on Early Warning Systems for Mobile Populations To support the integration of mobility considerations into MHEWS, UNDRR, WMO, ITU, IFRC and IOM jointly developed the Operational Guidance on Early Warning Systems for Mobile Populations. This webinar marks the official launch of the guidance.
